zh.title: 记忆恢复了，待处理工作也恢复了吗？
zh.summary: 固定源码的隔离类探针显示，历史记忆与待处理收件箱可能跨越不同持久化边界；辅助函数存在不等于检查点已经调用它。

en.title: Memory was restored. Was pending work restored too?
en.summary: A pinned source-derived class probe separates historical memory from pending inbox persistence. Available helpers do not establish checkpoint integration.
